old_note: *Fill Sion (Zion) with your unspeakable oracles, and your people with your glory.* Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 36:14 names the wisdom-stream's articulation of the prayer-for-the-glory-to-fill-Tsion (Zion) substance the King's-arriving-at-Yerushalayim (Jerusalem) walks-out. The framework reads the verse against Matt 21:9's *Hoshia-na (Hosanna) in the highest* + Matt 21:10's *all the city was moved.* The wisdom-stream-substance the Sirach 36 passage walks is the prayer-for-the-Messianic-arrival-substance — *make the time short, remember the covenant* (v.8) + *gather all the tribes of Ya'aqov (Jacob) together* (v.11) + *fill Sion with your unspeakable oracles* (v.14) + *let your prophets be found faithful* (v.16). The substance the multitudes cry at the entry walks-into the substance the wisdom-stream-prayer had-named the Father-for: the glory-arriving-at-Tsion is the King-arriving-at-the-city. The Greek *eseisthē* the Matthean account uses for *all the city was moved* (v.10) carries the same root the Matt 27:51 earthquake-substance and the Matt 28:2 resurrection-earthquake-substance carry — the wisdom-stream had-named the Father's-glory-arriving as the substance-that-fills-Tsion; the gospel walks the same substance at the King-arriving-into-the-shaken-city.

The framework reads the verse against Matt 26:50's *And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come?* The substantial-King-of-Yashar'el (Israel)'s *Friend* (Greek *hetaire*) address to the substantial-Yahudah-Iscariot (Judas Iscariot)-substance at-the-substantial-arrest is the substantial-grief-of-the-King-at-the-substantial-companion-and-friend-turned-to-an-enemy-substance the wisdom-stream had named-substantively the substance-for. The substantial-grief-substance walks the substantial Psalm 41:9 substance the prophet-David walked (*yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me*) the King-of-Yashar'el (Israel) cites at John 13:18 walks-into-substantively. The substantial-King-of-Yashar'el (Israel)-substance walks-substantively-the-substantial-grief-to-death-substance the substantial Matthew 26:38 substance (*my soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death*) walks-substantively-the-substantial-substance-of-the-substantial-grief-to-death-the-companion-and-friend-turned-to-an-enemy-substance the wisdom-stream had named-substantively. The framework reads this in continuity with the substantial-Suffering-Servant-substance the prophet-Yeshayahu (Isaiah) walked at Isaiah 53:3 (*he is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief*) walks-into directly.

old_note: *My son, in your sickness be not negligent: but pray to Yahuah (God), and he will make you whole.* Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 38:9 names the wisdom-stream's prescribed-healing-architecture: pray to the Most High first; he will make you whole. The bleeding-woman of Matt 9:20-22 walks an inversion of the Sirach-38 architecture in one register and a fulfillment in another. The framework reads the inversion: she does not pray-then-wait for the indirect-healing-flow Sirach prescribes; she touches the King's garment directly because the King is the Formed-Voice through whom the Most High's healing-flow operates in present-tense-direct.
